summary: First iteration: Backend pytest suite (35 tests) and Playwright smoke covering auth, permissions, dashboard, pages, currency toggle, Users permission matrix, and restricted-user flow. All backend tests pass; all tested frontend flows pass.

issues: Recharts prints width/height=-1 warnings when cashflow container initially has 0 size; harmless but could be fixed by setting a minHeight on the chart wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Add minHeight on Nakit Akışı chart container to silence recharts width/height=-1 warnings when there are no banks/txs yet.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; works on current FastAPI but should migrate to lifespan handlers.
login endpoint sets cookie with samesite=none+secure=True which requires HTTPS; preview is HTTPS so OK, but local dev over HTTP won't persist the cookie — Bearer token path still works.

/api/caris GET auto-creates a cari when confirming an invoice without match using case-insensitive regex on vendor; vendor is user-controlled and injected into regex — a '.*' style vendor is harmless here but worth escaping with re.escape to be safe.
Transactions created via transfer have transfer_id but no category/cari; dashboard explicitly filters transfer_id out which is correct.
banks_with_balance recomputes balance by scanning ALL paid transactions per request (O(banks*txs)); fine for MVP, consider aggregation when data grows.
No endpoint to delete an invoice file from storage on soft-delete — orphan objects accumulate.
seed_data_creation: All test data created with TEST_/test_ prefix was cleaned up by TestZCleanup. Rates and category edits were restored to original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run serial via '-n 0' because tests share module-level state across classes. Frontend data-testids verified: login-*, nav-*-link, currency-toggle-{try,usd,eur}, permission-checkbox-{email}-{module}, save-permissions-{email} (appears only when dirty), rate-usd-input, save-rates-button, access-restricted, add-user-button. Invoice upload (AI extract) was NOT exercised end-to-end — only mime validation covered.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
